prompt.zh-TW: 木岸家具年底的非流動負債 {{money:vars.ncl}}、股東權益總額 {{money:vars.equity}}，機器設備淨額 {{money:vars.ppe}}。依課程 Excel 口徑計算{{term:tm_8eyx0srs|plain}}（課程用的舊稱，現行年報名稱見名詞卡），以百分比作答。
prompt.en: At year end Woodbank Furniture has non-current liabilities of {{money:vars.ncl}}, total equity of {{money:vars.equity}} and machinery and equipment (net) of {{money:vars.ppe}}. Using the course Excel basis, what is the {{term:tm_8eyx0srs|plain}} (the older name used by the course; see the term card for the current annual-report name)? Answer as a percentage.

explanation.zh-TW: 長期資金＝{{term:tm_y37ymj9w}}＋{{term:tm_adqjyfqg}}，也就是 {{money:vars.equity}} 加 {{money:vars.ncl}}，再除以機器設備淨額 {{money:vars.ppe}}。{{term:tm_8eyx0srs}}問的是「長期的錢夠不夠蓋住長期的資產」：超過 {{percent:1|digits=0}}，表示固定資產全部由長期資金支應，沒有拿短期借款去買長期資產。
explanation.en: Long-term funds = {{term:tm_y37ymj9w}} + {{term:tm_adqjyfqg}}, that is {{money:vars.equity}} plus {{money:vars.ncl}}, divided by machinery and equipment (net) of {{money:vars.ppe}}. The {{term:tm_8eyx0srs}} asks whether long-term money covers long-term assets: above {{percent:1|digits=0}}, the fixed assets are fully funded by long-term money and no short-term borrowing was used to buy them.
